{{Quote|I want an immediate priority records search through Bastion Military Control. Find out where the ''Relentless'' has gone.|Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
'''Bastion Military Control''' was an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] demanded that the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] be located by searching records through Bastion Military Control.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />
